scripts.sb:start: pnpm run with-env supabase status || pnpm run with-env supabase start
scripts.sb:link: SB_PROJECT_ID=$(dotenvx get SB_PROJECT_ID -f ../../.env.development) SB_DB_PASSWORD=$(dotenvx get SB_DB_PASSWORD -f ../../.env.development) && pnpm run with-env supabase link --project-ref $SB_PROJECT_ID --password $SB_DB_PASSWORD
scripts.db:gen-migration: pnpm sb:stop && pnpm run with-env supabase db diff -f
scripts.db:migrate: pnpm sb:start && pnpm run with-env supabase migration up --include-all && pnpm db:gen-types && pnpm db:prepare-seed && pnpm run with-env supabase db start
scripts.db:reset: pnpm run with-env supabase db reset && pnpm db:prepare-seed && pnpm run with-env supabase db reset && pnpm db:gen-types
scripts.db:gen-types: supabase gen types typescript --local > ../../libs/schemas/src/dbTypes.gen.ts && pnpm in:schemas gen-schemas
scripts.fn:test: cd supabase/functions && deno test --allow-all tests/*-test.ts --env=../../../../.env.test --import-map deno.json
